description: Plan Tasks 7 and 8: Step Functions stage handlers in a new pipeline/stages.py, handler.py reduced to an alias, and infra/template.yaml rewritten around an AWS::Serverless::StateMachine with an ASL file at infra/statemachine/rebellion.asl.json. Depends on FEAT-002 (uses transform.extract_one/assemble, RawArticle.to_json/from_json, ensure_agent_ready).
steps: Create pipeline/stages.py. Define a Storage protocol (put(key, body: bytes, content_type, cache_control=None), get(key) -> bytes) with S3Storage(bucket, client=None) (boto3 imported lazily inside the method/constructor that needs it) and InMemoryStorage (dict-backed, exposes its objects for tests). Define a Timeline protocol (record(item: dict)) with DynamoTimeline(table_name, table=None) (lazy boto3 resource) and InMemoryTimeline (list of items). Module-level helpers build defaults from env vars SNAPSHOT_BUCKET, TIMELINE_TABLE; every stage function accepts optional keyword injections (storage=, timeline=, extractor=, ready_check=, fetcher=) so tests never touch AWS.

Env parsing (Task 1): add a helper (e.g. `positive_int_env(name, default)`) used for PER_FEED_LIMIT: a positive int string -> that int; missing, empty, non-numeric, zero or negative -> sources.PER_FEED_LIMIT (25). OFFLINE=='1' toggles curated input; AGENT_MODEL_ID, AGENT_REGION read for preflight/extract.

preflight(event, context): calls agent_extract.ensure_agent_ready(AGENT_MODEL_ID or None, AGENT_REGION or None) (injectable); lets AgentUnavailable propagate so the execution fails; returns {model_id, report_date} where report_date = event.get('report_date') or today UTC iso.

fetch(event, context): input has report_date and execution name (key `execution`, passed from $$.Execution.Name). Calls transform.fetch_articles(report_date, offline, per_feed_limit=env) and writes each article as JSON (RawArticle.to_json) to `staging/{report_date}/{execution}/articles/{n}.json` (n from 1, application/json). Returns {items: [{key}], report_date, execution}.

extract(event, context): input {key, model_id?}. Reads the article, builds StrandsExtractor(model_id=event model_id or env or DEFAULT_MODEL_ID, region=AGENT_REGION) unless injected, calls transform.extract_one, writes the dossier JSON to the sibling key `.../dossiers/{n}.json`, returns {key, dossier_key, status: 'ok'}. Must NOT catch exceptions: they propagate so the Step Functions Retry/Catch applies.

assemble(event, context): input {report_date, execution, results: [...Map outputs...]}; each result is either {key, dossier_key, status:'ok'} or {key, status:'discarded', error?}. Load articles for every result and dossiers for ok ones, build (article, dossier|None) pairs in staging order (sort by n), call transform.assemble(pairs, date). On ReportAborted: record Timeline {pk:'rebellion', date, status:'aborted', discarded, total, generated_at} and return {published: false, report_date, discarded, total}; do NOT write any snapshots/ key. Otherwise publish JSON (transform.encode_json) and binary (binary.encode) to `snapshots/{date}/snapshot.json|bin` and `snapshots/latest/snapshot.json|bin` with the same ContentType and CacheControl 'max-age=300' as the old handler._publish_s3, record Timeline {pk, date, status:'published', total, by_severity, discarded, generated_at}, and return {published: true, report_date, total, by_severity, discarded}.

pipeline/handler.py: replace with a thin alias module that documents the Step Functions flow and re-exports preflight, fetch, extract, assemble from stages.py. No `run(use_agent=...)`, no USE_AGENT, no legacy monolithic handler. Do not delete the file.

Create infra/statemachine/rebellion.asl.json: States Preflight (Task, Lambda invoke via ${PreflightFunctionArn}, Parameters include report_date from input if present) -> Fetch (passes execution name from $$.Execution.Name) -> ExtractEach (Map, ItemsPath $.items, ItemSelector with key, model_id, report_date; ItemProcessor ProcessorConfig Mode INLINE; MaxConcurrency 5; inner Task Extract with Retry [{ErrorEquals:['States.ALL'], IntervalSeconds:10, MaxAttempts:2, BackoffRate:2}] and Catch [{ErrorEquals:['States.ALL'], ResultPath:'$.error', Next:'Discard'}]; Discard is a Pass that outputs {key.$:'$.key', status:'discarded'} and End) with ResultPath $.results -> Assemble (Task) -> PublishedChoice (Choice: $.published BooleanEquals false -> ReportAbortedFail (Fail with Error 'ReportAborted'), Default -> Done (Succeed)). Use plain Lambda ARN Resource or arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke with OutputSelector/ResultSelector $.Payload consistently so the outputs match what stages.py returns.

Rewrite infra/template.yaml: keep Description narrative updated, Globals (python3.13, arm64, MemorySize 512), SnapshotBucket (add LifecycleConfiguration rule expiring prefix `staging/` after 7 days), TimelineTable unchanged, CdnOAC, Cdn, SnapshotBucketPolicy, Outputs (+ StateMachineArn). Parameters: ScheduleExpression (unchanged default), PerFeedLimit (String, default "25"), AgentModelId (default us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8), AgentRegion (default ""). Remove UseAgent and the EnableAgent condition. Four AWS::Serverless::Function resources with CodeUri ../ and Handler pipeline.stages.preflight|fetch|extract|assemble: PreflightFunction (Timeout 60), FetchFunction (Timeout 120; env PER_FEED_LIMIT, SNAPSHOT_BUCKET; S3WritePolicy), ExtractFunction (Timeout 300; env AGENT_MODEL_ID, AGENT_REGION, SNAPSHOT_BUCKET; S3CrudPolicy or scoped read+write), AssembleFunction (Timeout 120; S3CrudPolicy + DynamoDBCrudPolicy on TimelineTable). Bedrock statement (bedrock:InvokeModel, InvokeModelWithResponseStream, Converse, ConverseStream, GetInferenceProfile, GetFoundationModel on foundation-model/* and account inference-profile/*) only on PreflightFunction and ExtractFunction. AWS::Serverless::StateMachine RebellionStateMachine with DefinitionUri statemachine/rebellion.asl.json, DefinitionSubstitutions for the four function ARNs, Policies LambdaInvokePolicy per function, and the Schedule event (ScheduleExpression, name rebellion-daily) moved here. No SQS anywhere.

Add pipeline/tests/test_stages.py: (a) in-memory end-to-end: preflight (stub ready_check) -> fetch (stub fetcher returning 3-4 RawArticles, or offline curated) -> extract each with a stub extractor -> assemble with InMemoryStorage/InMemoryTimeline; assert snapshots/latest + dated keys exist, the JSON decodes, binary decodes via pipeline.binary.decode, timeline status 'published'; (b) extract propagates a stub exception (pytest.raises) and writes no dossier; (c) assemble with >20% discarded results returns published False, writes no snapshots/ keys (and leaves a pre-seeded snapshots/latest object untouched), and records a timeline item with status 'aborted'; (d) PER_FEED_LIMIT env parsing: '10' -> 10, 'abc', '0', '-3', '' and unset -> 25.

Add pipeline/tests/test_statemachine.py: load infra/statemachine/rebellion.asl.json (path relative to repo root via Path(__file__)) and assert StartAt, the Preflight/Fetch/Map/Assemble/Choice/Fail states exist, Map MaxConcurrency == 5, inner Retry has ErrorEquals ['States.ALL'], MaxAttempts 2, IntervalSeconds 10, BackoffRate 2, Catch goes to a Pass state producing status 'discarded', Choice routes published == false to a Fail state. Optionally parse infra/template.yaml with a YAML loader that tolerates CloudFormation tags (only if PyYAML is already installed; otherwise do simple text assertions) to assert no UseAgent/EnableAgent and PerFeedLimit default '25'.
Run full suite + ruff + black. If `sam` or `cfn-lint` exists, run `sam validate -t infra/template.yaml --lint`; otherwise record that it could not be run.
Check whether SAM can find a requirements.txt for CodeUri ../ (repo root has none; pipeline/requirements.txt is nested). Do not restructure packaging; record the finding so the user can decide.
acceptance_criteria: pipeline/stages.py exposes preflight, fetch, extract, assemble, S3Storage, InMemoryStorage
assemble aborts without writing snapshots/ and records status 'aborted' (tested)
infra/template.yaml contains no UseAgent, EnableAgent, USE_AGENT or SQS; has PerFeedLimit default "25" and an AWS::Serverless::StateMachine with the schedule
ASL test asserts Retry/Catch/MaxConcurrency/Choice and passes
Full pytest suite, ruff, black clean
findings: 173 tests green (41 new: test_stages.py, test_statemachine.py); ruff + black clean; ASL JSON loads. New: pipeline/stages.py (Storage/Timeline protocols, S3Storage, InMemoryStorage, DynamoTimeline, InMemoryTimeline, positive_int_env, preflight/fetch/extract/assemble); pipeline/handler.py is now a re-export alias (no run/USE_AGENT); infra/statemachine/rebellion.asl.json; infra/template.yaml rewritten (4 functions with Handler pipeline.stages.*, StateMachine owns the Schedule, PerFeedLimit default '25' with AllowedPattern, staging/ lifecycle 7d, StateMachineArn output, no UseAgent/EnableAgent/SQS). ASL uses arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke; Preflight passes the whole input (Payload.$ '$') so a missing report_date is fine; Fetch result is kept under $.staged via ResultSelector {items, execution}; Map ItemsPath $.staged.items, ResultPath $.results; Assemble Payload {report_date, execution, results}. Preflight/Fetch/Assemble also retry transient Lambda.* errors (3 attempts). Security: staging keys and execution names are validated by regex; assemble rejects result keys from another date/execution. S3 IAM is prefix-scoped (Fetch PutObject staging/*, Extract Get+Put staging/*, Assemble Get staging/* + Put snapshots/*); Assemble uses DynamoDBWritePolicy. Bedrock statement only on Preflight and Extract. Note: the existing CloudFront bucket policy grants GetObject on /* so staging/ objects are CDN-readable (public news text only; unchanged). Timeline rows: published {pk,date,status,total,by_severity,discarded,generated_at}; aborted {pk,date,status,discarded,total,generated_at}. TIMELINE_TABLE unset -> no timeline write; SNAPSHOT_BUCKET unset -> RuntimeError. Snapshot JSON top-level key is 'date' (not report_date). sam and cfn-lint are not installed: sam validate NOT run. PyYAML 6.0.3 is in .venv; template tests parse YAML with a loader tolerating CFN tags (importorskip). Packaging gap (not fixed, user decision): CodeUri ../ is the repo root, which has no requirements.txt (only pipeline/requirements.txt), so sam build will NOT install strands-agents/pydantic/defusedxml; Preflight/Extract would fail with AgentUnavailable at runtime. CodeUri ../ also bundles frontend/ (incl. node_modules) and .venv into each function. Options: add a root requirements.txt, or move CodeUri to a dedicated build dir. Docs (README, AGENTS.md, .kiro steering) still mention handler.py/USE_AGENT: FEAT-004.
